sentence: This project develops theoretical methods to describe unconventional metals in which electrons are strongly entangled over long distances.
This project studies how planarian flatworms regrow missing parts by finding chemical signals that let cells communicate with one another.
This project develops computational methods that identify and measure protein post translational modifications using mass spectrometry data.
This project develops machine learning methods that combine acoustic and visual information so underwater robots can map sites and pinpoint their own location.
This project builds digital models of human and animal brains to examine how head impacts cause brain injury.
This project builds a course on the smart use of autonomous underwater vehicles for tasks such as lake bottom surface mapping.
This project develops laboratory modules for research on bioengineering antibodies, which are proteins involved in immune responses.
This project builds a curriculum on quantum computing that covers algorithms, hardware and software, along with security threats.
This project tries to steer the chaotic flows of a light-responsive active fluid toward useful behaviors such as persistent rotation of an inclusion.
This project studies how lipids in the membrane change the way a protein that triggers vesicle fusion works.
This project holds workshops and long programs that connect mathematics with fields such as medicine, engineering and the physical sciences.
This project develops machine learning methods that connect vision and language data while preserving the relationships between them.
This project builds an artificial intelligence framework that monitors advanced metal alloys during additive manufacturing and controls the process in real time.
This project develops computational methods that predict energies of much larger molecules with very high accuracy.
This project studies how Antarctic fishes cope with low oxygen by comparing four species with a related fish from warmer coastal regions.
This project builds an algorithm that maps networks of transcription factors to find drug targets for diseases.
This project develops magnetic resonance tools to study the structure of liquid water near proteins and surfaces.
